programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world
This time, Martyna Wojciechowska travels through Asia and Europe, wanting to learn the story of the youngest heroine so far.First, he stops in Hong Kong, where Hanson Robotics is headquartered.The most recognizable humanoid robot - Sophia, was created there.The host follows her to London.He intends to check why the android arouses such extreme emotions.This "woman" has dated Will Smith, sung with Jimmy Fallon, made a speech at the UN meeting, and has been photographed on the covers of numerous magazines.Although it is not the most modern machine in the world, it still causes controversy and provokes discussion regarding artificial intelligence.

Martyna Wojciechowska visits Canada.Matricia Bauer, who lives in the heart of Jasper National Park in the Rocky Mountains, tells her story.Locals know her as a guide, leader and drum artist.She is a representative of the Kri people.When she was five years old, she was separated from her family as part of a government program called the '60s captive.It involved placing thousands of children from indigenous communities up for adoption by middle-class white families.It was about assimilation with the West.Another example of colonization were boarding schools, where cultural genocide occurred.About 150,000 people lost their childhood there.Frieda, Marticia's mentor, went to one of such places.It proves that even despite tragic experiences, you can find the strength to discover your own identity and then defend it.

At first glance, Brazil is very open, but in fact it is a country full of contrasts.Violence and macho culture are a brutal everyday reality for many here.For over a decade, it has been at the top of the shameful statistics regarding the murders of transgender people.Over a hundred people die there every year because of transphobia.During her next trip, Martyna Wojciechowska visits Fortaleza, where Lara Nicole lives.She is an activist who opposes the violence prevalent in the world and fights for her own rights and those of other transgender people.She dreams of living to the age of forty, while the average life expectancy of transgender people in Brazil is thirty-five years.Faced with social exclusion, nearly 90% of transgender women have to work on the streets.They remain vulnerable to all forms of violence.For this reason, Lara created Casa Transformar - a safe place for people from the LGBTQ+ community.They can get support.

This time Martyna goes to Florida, which is Americans' favorite place to spend their retirement.They move there to spend the autumn of their lives walking along the seaside and watching sunsets.However, for the heroines of this episode - Donna and her bandmates - this is definitely not enough.The Calendar Girls group consists of thirty women aged 52 to 82.The women were united by their passion for dance and physical activity.They meet for training several times a week and take part in almost 200 performances a year.With their colorful and joyful repertoire, they entertain residents of retirement homes and financially support the training of guide dogs.The heroines of the episode prove that old age is joy.

programs.title: Man vs World
programs.desc: Rob Bell, an adventurer, athlete and engineer, sets off on a journey during which he will travel only in vehicles powered by human muscles.Every morning the traveler will take on a new challenge.Wanting to visit as many places as possible and reach the destination before sunset, he will learn about disciplines such as canyoning, paragliding, mountain biking, mountain kayaking, coasteering and mountainboarding.During the expedition, he will cover difficult areas of South Africa, Poland, the Czech Republic and Great Britain.He will also meet many guides who will give him advice on how to navigate the cliffs, slopes and river gorges.When Rob undergoes this endurance test, he will see the world from a completely new perspective.
